purpose: Three preview-only XFCE retro themes; no app/runtime changes

variants.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Asset: PNG concept for a real XFCE desktop embedded inside the Android app Termux Job’s. Generate one polished, crisp front-on portrait UI mockup, canvas about 1024 x 2048 px. Not a photograph, no phone hardware, no perspective, no collage. Top quarter is the existing app chrome: pure black background, title ‘Termux Job’s’, three large rounded dark navigation buttons home/book/terminal with mint accent on terminal; underneath a dark session bar ‘Termux · /home’ and gear/folder icons; underneath compact dark pills ‘Рабочий стол’, ‘Программы’, ‘Сервер + Агент’. Below this is the tall full-width XFCE desktop viewport extending all the way to the bottom, with NO mobile chat composer and NO keyboard. The outer Android app chrome remains modern dark/mint; only the embedded desktop gets the retro theme. This must feel usable on a tall phone display. Make desktop shortcuts and especially the BOTTOM PANEL ICONS noticeably LARGE and finger readable: 56 px icons, generous 76 px bottom taskbar with readable labels, not a row of tiny symbols. Show four desktop icons Files, Terminal, Browser, Trash along left, and one modest open Files window in the upper third of the desktop, leaving the wallpaper center visible. Add no explanatory paragraphs or external captions. Desktop wallpaper has elegant italic lettering centered on three separate lines, EXACT: ‘Termux-job’s’ then ‘&’ then ‘X11’. Original themed graphics, no Microsoft logo, no literal Windows screenshot, no web branding. Keep the design feasible with XFCE GTK/XFWM themes, icons and wallpaper. Variant 1 — RETRO 98. Faithfully evoke the late-1990s Windows 98 visual vocabulary: teal desktop (#008080), light warm-gray raised beveled panels, square corners, thin dark navy active window title bar, white file view, crisp pixel-inspired folder and computer icons, classic compact bitmap-like UI lettering but readable high resolution. Large Start-style bottom button labeled ‘Menu’, gray taskbar with one ‘Files’ task button and three oversized quick-launch icons plus clock ‘23:30’. Wallpaper central italic brand is pale seafoam, understated. Window title ‘Files’, menu File Edit View, three folders Documents Downloads Pictures. Mild pixel-art character, not soft modern glass. This is a desktop theme preview inside the app, not a new app layout.
